title: Eval regression scorer: routing rules and incident binding for Console alerts
creator: Ravi Patel
description: Build a deterministic "regression scorer" and a flexible binding layer in Console that converts eval change signals (model/config/quantization changes) into routed notifications with dedupe and incident-binding semantics. Goal: reduce noise by 40% for config-driven eval regressions while preserving high-signal alerts for oncall teams and product owners.
acceptance_criteria: A regression-scoring service computes a numeric severity score for each eval change event and attaches it to the alert payload.
Console exposes a binding UI where PMs/Eng can map score ranges + tags (model, dataset, config flag) to notification targets (Slack channels, PagerDuty services, email).
Slack alerts for the same root regression (same model+test-suite+time-window) are deduplicated into a single threaded message; repeating signals update the thread rather than spawn new messages.

PagerDuty incidents are auto-bound to a single incident per top-level regression fingerprint for a configurable sticky window; subsequent related alerts increase incident urgency or add context instead of creating duplicates.
Dashboards show dedupe ratio, false positive rate (baseline), mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) for regression alerts, and a 40% reduction target in noise for initial rollout.
Backwards compatibility: existing alert webhook and Ops subscriptions continue to receive a backwards-compatible payload with a new 'regression_score' and 'regression_fingerprint' fields.
Automated integration tests covering scoring thresholds, thread creation/updates in Slack, and PagerDuty incident binding are included in the test suite.
technical_notes: Scoring heuristic: weighted aggregation of delta on primary eval metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/accuracy/custom score) + test volume + recent rollback frequency + model churn rate => normalized 0-100 severity score.
Fingerprint: canonicalized tuple (model_id, eval_suite_id, top_n_failed_prompts_hash, window_start_15m) hashed with HMAC using KMS key to generate stable cross-system ID.
Dedupe strategy: sticky window (configurable, default 24h) + thread affinity key for Slack; for PagerDuty use event deduplication via 'dedup_key' with escalation metadata updates.

Routing rules evaluation: ordered list of bindings in Console UI; first-match wins unless 'fanout' flag set. Bindings can reference labels on models (e.g., 'production', 'canary') and config flags (e.g., 'kv_cache_enabled').
Telemetry: emit 'regression.alert.generated', 'regression.alert.deduped', 'regression.alert.bound', 'regression.alert.escalated' with correlation_id and regression_fingerprint.
Backward compatibility: older clients ignore new fields; ensure event schema version is incremented (v2) and documented in console docs.
